cc:Work.dc:description: Shared top-view schematic; x forward/up the drawing, y left. Left and right grouped forward forces act at y=+b and -b, b=0.8 m. The jet acts at y=d=0.6 m. Point O is the centre of mass. Force arrows show direction, not magnitude; the stylized body is not Tesla geometry.
